---
title: "Short Vegetation + Hierarchy"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
params:
  plot_number: "00000"
  db_path: "../data/vpro.duckdb"
  parquet_dir: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
parquet_dir <- params$parquet_dir
if (!is.null(parquet_dir) && nzchar(trimws(parquet_dir))) {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
  tbls <- c("vw_USysAllVeg")
  for (tbl in tbls) {
    file_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", tbl), ".parquet")
    file_path <- file.path(parquet_dir, file_name)
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dbExecute(
        con,
        sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", tbl, gsub("'", "''", file_path))
      )
    }
  }
} else {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
}
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
veg <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT * FROM vw_USysAllVeg WHERE PlotNumber = ?",
  list(params$plot_number)
)

normalize_veg_cols <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  cols <- names(df)
  pick_col <- function(candidates) {
    idx <- which(tolower(cols) %in% tolower(candidates))
    if (length(idx) > 0) cols[[idx[1]]] else NA_character_
  }
  plot_col <- pick_col(c("plotnumber", "PlotNumber"))
  layer_col <- pick_col(c("mylayer", "layer", "MyLayer"))
  species_col <- pick_col(c("species", "species_code", "Species"))
  cover_col <- pick_col(c("covervalue", "cover_value", "cover", "CoverValue"))
  if (!is.na(plot_col)) df$PlotNumber <- df[[plot_col]]
  if (!is.na(layer_col)) df$MyLayer <- df[[layer_col]]
  if (!is.na(species_col)) df$Species <- df[[species_col]]
  if (!is.na(cover_col)) df$CoverValue <- df[[cover_col]]
  df
}

veg <- normalize_veg_cols(veg)

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

hier_col <- NULL
for (candidate in c("Hierarchy", "HierarchyName", "hierarchy")) {
  if (candidate %in% names(veg)) {
    hier_col <- candidate
    break
  }
}
```

# Plot: `r params$plot_number`

```{r veg-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(veg) > 0) {
  desired <- c("PlotNumber", "MyLayer", "Species", "CoverValue")
  cols <- intersect(desired, names(veg))
  if (!is.null(hier_col)) cols <- c(cols, hier_col)
  view <- veg[, cols, drop = FALSE]

  kbl(view, align = "l") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No vegetation data found.")
}
```
